adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` backfills from the old `site_settings` value by doing `records = val.split("\n")` and then unconditionally executing an `INSERT` for each `h` (`execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`). There is no `present?`/blank check or trimming/deduplication per entry. If the old setting contains blank lines (or whitespace-only lines), this will insert rows with `host` as `''` (allowed by `null: false`), bypassing the model’s `validates_format_of :host` since it’s raw SQL.
